Defined in: [packages/ai/src/activities/generateMotion/index.ts:792](https://github.com/TanStack/ai/blob/main/packages/ai/src/activities/generateMotion/index.ts#L792)

**`Experimental`**

Ask the provider to stop a motion job. This is a remote cancel, not a
local stop. Providers decide what happens: a queued job is usually
removed, a running job may still finish.
